pages.notes: Stock OBJ_WLANCONFIG_ID is per SSID (IGD.LD1.WLANn) but the radio parameters live in WLANBase (row 0 = 2.4 GHz = wlan0, row 1 = 5 GHz = wlan4); the selector here is the radio, not the SSID. Stock 'Mode' (OBJ param Standard) is not a DB field: the firmware derives it from 11nMode/11acMode/GreenField/BasicDataRates/OpDataRates, and the stock JS writes all of them together (b: Basic 0 Op 1 n 0; g: 2/3/0; b+g: 1/3/0; n: 1/3/1 + GreenField 1; g+n: 2/3/1; b+g+n: 1/3/1; a+n: 11ac 0 n 1; a+n+ac: 11ac 1 n 1). A composite 'mode' control would need a schema extension. Stock Channel 'Auto' writes AutoChannelEnabled=1 and keeps the last channel. Stock also writes per-SSID Priority (WLANCfg) when QoS type = SSID; that field is on the Wi-Fi networks page. Codes for TxPower, BandWidth, CountryCode, QosType, TxRate, SideBand come from the cmapi string<->code tables (see notes/wlan-security.md). liveKey values are MediaTek iwpriv keys whose value format equals the stored DB value; fields without liveKey take effect after reboot. UI-text notes moved here: [11nMode]: Part of the wireless mode; see notes. Stock sets it for every mode that contains 'n'. | [GreenField]: Stock writes 1 only for 'IEEE 802.11n Only'. | [BasicDataRates]: b: 0; g and g+n: 2; b+g, n, b+g+n: 1 (stock mapping). | [OpDataRates]: Stock: 1 for 802.11b only, 3 for every other 2.4 GHz mode. | [11axMode]: MT7603/MT7663 have no 802.11ax; always 0. | [CountryCode]: Selects the regulatory channel list (WLANCountry table). | [SideBand]: Only used at 40 MHz / 20-40 MHz with a fixed channel. Code meaning inferred; see notes. | [TxPower]: Stored as a code; TxPowerNum holds the percentage the firmware derives. | [SSIDIsolationEnable]: Hidden on the stock page; blocks traffic between SSIDs of this radio. | [11nMode]: Part of the wireless mode; see notes. Stock sets it for every mode that contains 'n'. | [11acMode]: On = Mixed a+n+ac (stock 'a,n,ac'); off = Mixed a+n. | [11axMode]: MT7603/MT7663 have no 802.11ax; always 0. | [CountryCode]: Selects the regulatory channel list (WLANCountry table). | [SideBand]: Only used at 40 MHz / 20-40 MHz with a fixed channel. Code meaning inferred; see notes. | [TxPower]: Stored as a code; TxPowerNum holds the percentage the firmware derives. | [SSIDIsolationEnable]: Hidden on the stock page; blocks traffic between SSIDs of this radio.

pages.title: Wi-Fi radio (user view)

pages.notes: Stock menu right=2 (user only). Same WLANBase fields as wlan-radio; the stock user page offers 100-20 % only (no 200 %). Stock enable checkbox greys out the other fields when off. liveKey SSID and HideSSID are verified on the device; NoForwarding and MaxStaNum are standard MediaTek AP keys, not yet verified on this build. UI-text notes moved here: [Enable]: Applied live by the wifi hook with ifconfig up/down. | [ESSID]: 1-32 printable ASCII characters (stock checkEssid). | [ESSIDPrefix]: Operator prefix the stock UI prepends to the SSID; usually empty. | [LocalSetEnable]: Stock hides SSIDs with LocalSetEnable=0 from every Wi-Fi page.

pages.notes: One stock page spans WLANCfg (auth fields), WLANPSK (row = SSID index, KeyPassphrase) and WLANWEP (4 rows per SSID: row = 4*ssid + keyIndex-1, hence four sections with rowMap). Stock mapping of the 'Authentication Type' list: Open System -> BeaconType None(0) or Basic(1)+WEPAuthMode None(0); Shared Key -> Basic(1)+SharedAuthentication(1); Both -> Basic(1)+Both(2); WPA-PSK -> WPA(2)+WPAAuthMode PSK(0)+WPAEncryptType; WPA2-PSK -> 11i(3)+11iAuthMode PSK(0)+11iEncryptType; WPA/WPA2-PSK -> WPAand11i(6)+both auth PSK+both encrypt types. BeaconType codes 4/5/7 (Basic+WPA mixes) and 8/9 (WAPI) exist in firmware but are not offered. WPA3 DMs (WPA3SAE*, WPA3T*) exist in WLANCfg but no stock page sets them and no WPA3 BeaconType code is known; not exposed. Live apply: only WPAPSK is a direct liveKey; AuthMode/EncrypType need a translation (see notes) so a security-mode change takes effect after reboot. WEP keys have no liveKey because the wifi hook maps any table row r to wlan{r}, which is wrong for WLANWEP (32 rows). WEP is also rejected by modern clients; consider hiding it. UI-text notes moved here: [BeaconType]: Stock 'Authentication Type'. Codes from the firmware BeaconType table. | [WEPLevel]: Stock OBJ name WEPEncryptionLevel. | [WPAEncryptType]: Stock writes the same value to WPA and WPA2 encryption in WPA/WPA2 mode. | [WPAGroupRekey]: Hidden on the stock page.

pages.title: WPS
pages.description: Wi-Fi Protected Setup on the main network of each band.

actions.label: Start WPS pairing
actions.note: Stock writes WpsPIN through OBJ_WPSPIN_ID (runtime, not a DB table). MediaTek equivalent, unverified on this build: iwpriv wlanN set WscConfMode=7; set WscMode=2 (PBC) or WscMode=1 + WscPinCode=<pin>; set WscGetConf=1.

pages.notes: Stock page only edits IGD.LD1.WLAN1.WPS (WLANWPS row 0) and OBJ_WPSPIN_ID. WLANWPS has 8 rows (one per SSID); only the main SSID of each band (rows 0 and 4) is offered here, which is what the MediaTek driver supports. WPS requires WPA2/WPA-WPA2 PSK and a visible SSID. No liveKey: the stored values (Enable 0/1, WPSMode 0/1) do not match iwpriv WscConfMode/WscMode values, so the hook skips them and the change applies after reboot.

pages.title: Wi-Fi access control
pages.description: Allow or block Wi-Fi clients by MAC address per SSID.
pages.applicableNote: Per-SSID MAC allow/deny list. Takes effect after a restart.

fields.label: MAC access policy
fields.help: Allow-only with an empty list locks every client out of this SSID.

pages.notes: Not in the stock menu. ACLPolicy codes (Disabled 0, Ban 1, Allow 2) come from the firmware string table; MACAddressControlEnabled is a separate flag whose interaction with ACLPolicy is unverified. List sections are readonly with no fields until the DM names are discovered: add one entry with sidbg and read the table back, or read the clone's cspd/libcmapi (not in this repo). Each list probably carries a WLAN ViewName column to tie entries to an SSID. UI-text notes moved here: [applicableNote]: Tables exist in the DB (WLANACLWHITE/WLANACLBLACK, max 40 rows each per pv) but no stock page uses them and both are empty, so their DM names are not known yet.

pages.title: Roaming and band steering
pages.description: Nudge clients between bands and between access points by signal strength.
pages.applicableNote: May not take effect on this router.

fields.label: Band steering
fields.help: Needs the same SSID and passphrase on SSID1 and SSID5.

pages.notes: Not in the stock menu. WLANBANDSTEERING defaults (Capability 1, RSSI -40/-80, 80 %, 75 %, 30 s) are firmware defaults. Threshold ranges are assumptions (dBm, -100..0); the stock firmware gives no JS limits. WLANROAMING row-to-band mapping is a guess (2 rows); Threshold1/2 semantics unknown. Stored Threshold*_RSSI are 0 by default, which the 'max 0' range allows. UI-text notes moved here: [applicableNote]: Tables present and defaulted, but no stock page; whether this clone's cspd acts on them is untested. | [roam0.title]: Roaming (row 1, probably 2.4 GHz) | [Start_time]: Units unknown (default 0). | [roam1.title]: Roaming (row 2, probably 5 GHz) | [Start_time]: Units unknown (default 0).

pages.title: Wi-Fi schedule
pages.description: Turn Wi-Fi on and off on a timetable.
pages.applicableNote: Scheduled Wi-Fi on/off times. Takes effect after a restart.
pages.notes: Not in the stock menu. TimeSetRule codes and the WlanTime action codes (TimeRFOn 0 / TimeRFOff 1) come from the firmware string tables; reference firmware defaults rows IGD.LD1.WlanTime1/2 with Hour and Minute DMs and rejects on/off intervals under 10 minutes. WlanTime columns are left out until a row can be read. A separate CMCC-style 'Wi-Fi sleep' timer (OBJ_WIFI_SLEEP_ID: Active/Enable/Time/Weekday, used by common_page/aset_wifiTimerSetting.lp) probably maps to SLWTIMEINFO; not mapped here. UI-text notes moved here: [applicableNote]: WlanTimeCfg/WlanTime exist but no stock page edits them; WlanTime is empty and its DM names are unknown. | [SetEnable]: Meaning unverified. | [SSIDMask]: Probably a bitmask of affected SSIDs (bit 0 = SSID1); unverified. 0 = all?

pages.title: WMM parameters
pages.description: Per access category contention parameters for each radio.
pages.notes: Not in the stock menu. WLANWMM has 8 rows: rows 0-3 = IGD.LD1.WLAN1.WMM1-4 (2.4 GHz radio), rows 4-7 = IGD.LD1.WLAN5.WMM1-4 (5 GHz); Type 0-3 = BE/BK/VI/VO (firmware table). Only applies when Wi-Fi QoS type = WMM. Ranges are the 802.11 field limits, not stock JS (there is none). No liveKey: MediaTek sets these as per-AC lists (APAifsn=a;b;c;d) and the hook's row->interface mapping is wrong for this table. Hook deliberately not set.

pages.notes: Read only on purpose: role and medium codes are undocumented.
